'''CreedCon Construction''' was a construction company that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
CreedCon Construction was owned and ran by [[Thaedius Creed]] and had an [[CreedCon office|office]] in the town of [[Hedrett]]. After entering intense negotiations with the [[Tarasin]], CreedCon gained the rights to build a race course deep in the jungles of Cularin. They began construction, but a group of its workers were captured by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]]. Creed sent out a security team to find the missing workers, but they too went missing, after being captured by a group of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that served Muun. Creed then summoned the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], to the Hedrett office, so that he could send them to find the missing workers. The heroes found and brought back the security, and later found the workers on [[Tilnes]], where Muun had taken them.
